enabled.title: Collect browser navigation events
enabled.description: Master on/off switch for this extension, settable centrally via Chrome/Edge enterprise policy. Defaults to true if unset.

excludedDomains.title: Excluded domains
excludedDomains.description: Hostnames (and their subdomains) that are NEVER reported, e.g. banking or healthcare sites, per organizational privacy policy. Example: ["mybank.example", "healthportal.example"].
